etsy.title: Cancer Zodiac Poster, Minimalist Zodiac Print, Cancer Birthday Gift, June July Birthday Decor
etsy.description:
A minimalist Cancer zodiac poster with the Cancer glyph, the June 21 – July 22 date range, and three traits: nurturing, intuitive, and sentimental.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a bedroom, gallery wall, or as a birthday gift for a Cancer (June 21 – July 22).

This listing is a physical poster print, for entertainment purposes only. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Cancer posters mostly show a crab illustration or constellation; nurturing and intuitive recur as trait words, matching this poster.
Dates are listed as June 21 or 22 to July 22; this poster prints June 21 - July 22. Physical prints show roughly $14-26 in snippets.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
One Amazon 11x14 unframed set offers a Cancer constellation design; single-sign Cancer prints were not separately checked.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'cancer zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
